## What doing it consciously looks like

Most of this I learned by screwing it up. Before making love I want enough information about the hard stuff that I’m not discovering it all after I’m bonded. Jealousy, other attractions, stress, old patterns, how recent the healing is, money, what each of us wants in a bad moment. I trust an answer more when there’s an actual situation around it.

But there’s a point where more questions mostly teach me what she says about herself. Then I need ordinary time. Ten profound conversations may tell me we can have profound conversations. They don’t tell me what she’s like on a boring day. And if I’m about to ignore some little “wait” feeling because I really want this to work, I want to ask the question before I keep going.

Wanting somebody also doesn’t tell me whether I should have children with her or build a life with her. My brain can turn “I’m taking a chance on her” into “she’s the right person” without much new evidence. Based on what? Sometimes nothing changed except that now I’m attached.
